infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Network Diagnostics Suite requires camera access to scan equipment QR/barcodes and attach installation evidence photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Network Diagnostics Suite requires GPS access to georeference technical diagnostic reports.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Network Diagnostics Suite scans and diagnoses equipment on your local telecommunications subnet.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Network Diagnostics Suite to scan equipment barcodes and document installations.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Network Diagnostics Suite to tag installation reports with site coordinates.
